name: Writerz
source:
"We are Writerz and we have come to rewrite your dreams."

By day, these four guys are trying to break into the show business, but by night, they're on a whole another task. Using their especially strong senses, they can read people's minds and with the help of a special crystal called Rennouseki, they can even enter their dreams to rewrite bad memories into pleasant ones. They have made it their duty to help people who are unable to move on due to the pain in their hearts.

Today, these guys have come to the office as they usually would...

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150428205320/http://writerz.jp/index.html]official website[/url]]
